cards.title: Why it works
items: Verify re-runs every roster command itself - a lane's ok:true is a claim, not a fact
Barrier fan-out, no quorum: an unsaid order is NAMED missing, never counted out of existence
Closeout rides after_partial: the crew closes no greener than the record verify found

cards.title: Contract
items: {{nodes}} nodes, {{echoes}} echo, {{fanouts}} fan-out: orders -> crew barrier -> re-run verify -> closeout
No seeds needed: every order is a stock shell command, so the shape runs as-is on a fresh install
